channel.title: Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty (rferl.org)

item.title: Matryoshka Satellites, Robotic Arms: Former US Space Force Commander Warns Of Russian, Chinese Threats
item.description: When a Russian “nesting-doll satellite” maneuvered into close proximity to a US satellite last June, the concern at US Space Force was “would they release a kill vehicle from that and attack the satellite?”

item.title: First Day Of Ukraine-Russia Peace Talks In Abu Dhabi End, Will Head To Second Day
item.description: The first day of US-facilitated peace talks between Ukraine and Russia in the United Arab Emirates ended as they look to move toward a deal to end their war as the fighting nears its fourth anniversary.

item.title: Bishkek Hosts B5+1 Forum As Central Asia Eyes Stronger Economic Ties With US
item.description: Bishkek is hosting the B5+1 Forum this week, bringing together officials and business leaders from Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, and the United States to explore investment opportunities and deepen economic ties.

item.title: Iranian Students Turn Memorials Into Protests
item.description: Students at universities throughout Iran are gathering to honor classmates who were killed during nationwide protests in January. In Mashhad, Tabriz, and Shiraz, students have chanted, held sit-ins, and refused to take school exams.

item.title: What's Behind The Unprecedented Attacks In Pakistan’s Balochistan?
item.description: Pakistan has used violence and political repression to stamp out a decades-old insurgency in Balochistan Province. The largest-ever attacks in the region have called into question that strategy.

item.title: The Key Sticking Points To A US-Iran Deal Aimed At Averting War
item.description: White House envoy Steve Witkoff and Iran's FM Abbas Araqchi are set to meet on February 6 in a last-ditch bid to avert war. As a US naval armada nears, Tehran is facing a tough choice: Make a slew of concessions for an end to Washington's "maximum pressure" policy, or risk war.

item.title: Father Mourns Teenage Son Killed in Russian Drone Strike in Zaporizhzhya
item.description: A man mourns his teenage son, killed in a Russian drone strike on Zaporizhzhya that also claimed the life of the boy’s girlfriend. Russia also launched one of its largest strikes of 2026 on energy infrastructure, hitting facilities in the Kyiv and Kharkiv regions.

item.title: Iran, US Prepare To Resume Talks As New Activity Spotted At Iranian Nuclear Sites
item.description: With US warships heading toward Iran, diplomats from the two countries are scheduled to resume high-stake talks at a meeting on February 6. The officials will reopen discussions over Iran's nuclear program, which was disrupted by US strikes on key nuclear facilities last June.

item.title: US Congress Approves Funds For Baltics As Russia Tests NATO's Eastern Flank
item.description: The US Congress has approved $200 million in security assistance for the Baltic states as Russian activity along NATO’s eastern flank intensifies.

item.title: Live Blog: Rubio: US Is Prepared To Engage With Iran
item.description: Thousands of Iranians are dead or detained in a brutal crackdown after they took to the streets in what is seen as the biggest threat to the Islamic regime in years. Journalists from RFE/RL’s Iranian service, Radio Farda, bring you the latest developments, analysis, and reporting from on the ground.
